messages:
Leo (AE): Quick POC ask from NimbusPay 1 they want an ISO excerpt, a signed pen-test attestation, and a 2-hour authenticated scan window for staging. Can we support next Wed 14:00 PDT?
Mira (Solutions Eng): I can package an ISO excerpt + minimal network diagram. For an authenticated scan we need a scoped test account and a short-lived credential pattern (no production keys). Legal will need the signer and indemnity language.
Jas (Security): Authenticated scan adds requirements: test account must have read-only app-level scope, no access to crypto keys/HSM, and MFA disabled for that account during the window. We also require the scanning IPs and user-agent to whitelist.
Leo (AE): Nimbus contact: secops@nimbuspay.com. They say the scanner uses two source IPs: 18.205.33.10, 18.205.33.11. UA: "NimbusScan/5.0".
Omar (Infra): Fine to open for /32s. Provide exact CIDRs. Also confirm rate and credential rotation plan so we can set alarms and a short TTL for creds.
Mira (Solutions Eng): Test account will be created with username nimbus-poc-scan and password rotated after the window. We'll mark account in audit logs.
Jas (Security): Please ensure the scan excludes any internal-only endpoints and keys. We'll redact any SSO token traces before sharing artifacts.
Leo (AE): Filling legal fields now per LegalBot template. signer_name: Priya Kaur; signer_title: Head of Security; company_name: NimbusPay Inc.; testing_scope: authenticated external scan against staging app endpoints only, using provided read-only test account; desired_return_email: secops@nimbuspay.com
LegalBot: Received fields. Also require organization's DUNS or registered company ID for the attestation. Reply with that and we'll include the standard indemnity paragraph.
Leo (AE): Nimbus replied: DUNS 12-345-6789.
Mira (Solutions Eng): Uploaded ISO excerpt + diagram + recommended test-account creation steps to presigned S3 (24h expiry): https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood-evidence-temp/nimbus/iso-scan-package.zip?X-Amz-Expires=86400
Jas (Security): I'll review the package and flag any items for redaction. Once legal produces signed PDF, we'll only share the redacted version with Nimbus.
Omar (Infra): Scheduling firewall change: open 18.205.33.10/32 and 18.205.33.11/32 at Wed 13:50 PDT, close at 15:10 PDT. We'll enable extra monitoring and auto-rollback on anomalous traffic.
Mira (Solutions Eng): Test-account details (will DM): username nimbus-poc-scan, ephemeral password (rotated in 3h).
LegalBot: Drafting signed pen-test attestation now. Expect signed PDF within 48h after verification.
Leo (AE): Great, passing to Nimbus: secops@nimbuspay.com. Will update if any blocker pops up. :white_check_mark:
